pages.text: A $(item)Tavern Sign$() hangs out from a wall on its iron bracket. Repaint it with what you serve: right-click it with a mug of beer for an alehouse, wine for a wine bar, a spirit for a distillery, or a cask for a cellar.
A $(item)Mug Rack$() holds four empty mugs, hung by their handles from its pegs. A $(item)Hop Garland$() is fresh bines strung along a wall: hang several in a row and they join into one.

pages.name: A Tavern Wall
pages.text: A hop garland strung along the top, a Mug Rack and a sign for a wine bar.
